method.rule: buy at the first bar's open of each calendar month, sell at the last bar's close
method.unit: percent of the month's open price
method.incomplete_months: excluded; the final month of each series is dropped
method.why_daily: a weekly bar straddles the month boundary, so a weekly-derived month open can belong to the previous month
method.xauusd_pre_1980_excluded: that part of the export is a close-only reconstruction — every weekly bar has high == low
method.costs_excluded: spread, commission, carry and futures roll are not modelled
method.prior_work: RS-TX-20260728-001 measured TX under the section 14 weekly contract

title: Buy the month open, sell the month close — XAUUSD and TX
